ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) with high-intensity pixels limited to localized anomalies; ratio estimated at <10% high-intensity coverage across the visible ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: No macro-scale geometric mottling or banding; the visible surface presents as a contiguous low-intensity field punctuated by high-intensity focal points at distal tips and linear markings in central and medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the vertical extent of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the trailing edge boundary; amplitude of peaks increases distal to the median notch, reaching maximal variance at the outer lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries exhibit a moderate convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips along the trailing edge contour.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated in high-density groups at the distal-most points of both the left and right fluke lobes, consistent with localized surface growth.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of high intensity relative to the dark fluke background, predominantly oriented horizontally and diagonally across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-intensity circular markers (likely barnacles) at distal lobe tips; numerous light-colored linear abrasions present on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Minor irregular notch situated on the trailing edge of the right lobe, distal to the central median notch.
